description: Create a 10-minute signed download link (TXT, SRT, VTT, Markdown, or JSON) for a transcript the account already has, or for a transcribed upload. Call this when the user wants a file or a link to a file: hand them the returned url and say it expires in 10 minutes. Needs a signed-in connection. The launcher Download action calls it too, so a host that cannot start a download itself still gives the user the link.

diarize.description: Must match the original fetch; requires engine=stt.

engine.description: Download the speech-to-text transcript for a video fetched with engine=stt.

tier.description: Speech tier for engine=stt; auto resolves to whichever artifact exists.

upload_id.description: Upload id of a transcribed file.

url.description: YouTube video URL or 11-character video ID.

name: transcriptlab_export_link
title: Create a download link
